class.name: NNDistanceToVector2SearchCriterion
class.brief_description: Filters and scores [Node2D] candidates by distance to a global 2D position.
class.description: Measures each [Node2D] candidate's distance to [member distance_to_vector] across [member min_distance]..[member max_distance] (using squared distance for speed). Use to find targets near, far from, or within a specific range of a 2D coordinate (combine with an inverted [member NNNQSSearchCriteria.activation_curve] to prefer closer candidates). To track a moving node instead, use [NNDistanceToNode2DSearchCriterion].

members.member: Global 2D position to measure candidate distances to.
Maximum distance. Maps to [code]1.0[/code] when scoring; farther candidates are filtered out when filtering is enabled. Must be greater than [member min_distance].
Minimum distance. Maps to [code]0.0[/code] when scoring; closer candidates are filtered out when filtering is enabled. Must be non-negative and less than [member max_distance].
